profile_text.body:
Suno is a for-profit startup founded in 2022 and headquartered in Cambridge, MA, USA. Its website describes it as an AI music generator that creates complete original songs, including vocals, lyrics, and full production, from a single text prompt in under a minute. The company says users can make music for free every day, remix tracks, make beats, and share music, and it describes itself as the #1 AI music generator. Paid plans include a Pro plan with 500 songs a month, royalty free music, access to v5.5, commercial use rights, priority generation, the Song Editor, stem separation, and audio uploads of up to 8 minutes, and a Premier plan with 2,000 songs a month, Suno Studio, a multitrack editor, MIDI export, Persona Voices, and early access to new features.

Suno's product is categorized under Voice & Audio, with a note that music generation and IP provenance are relevant. Court records name Suno in twelve cases across federal district courts, including UMG Recordings, Inc. v. Suno, Inc., Beckham v. Suno, Inc., Gerencia 360 Music, Inc. v. Suno, Inc., Lowery v. Suno, Inc., Round Hill Music LP v. Suno, Inc., Gawronski v. Suno Inc., Rugnetta v. Suno, Inc., Pilavian v. Suno, Inc., Reyna v. Suno, Inc., S.A. Jamendo v. Suno Inc., Poseidon Wave Media LLC v. Suno, Inc., and Woulard v. Suno, Inc. The cases are spread across the District of Massachusetts, Northern District of California, Southern District of Texas, Southern District of New York, and Northern District of Illinois. Separately, Suno is associated with 191 Massachusetts law exposure entries.
